slack.title: Slack
slack.onPeopleList: — you’re on the People list, so your mentions get through.
slack.captionMention: Mention @WeruBWorker in any channel it’s invited to — a session opens here, and the answer lands back in Slack as a thread.
slack.captionThread: Mention it again inside the thread — the conversation continues in the same session, context intact. The thread is the session.
slack.captionTeammates: Teammates aren’t auto-trusted: their first mention waits for your OK, then they’re on the People list.
slack.stickyThread: the answer comes back as a thread ↑
slack.stickySameConv: chatting in the thread continues the SAME conversation →
slack.stickyWaitOk: first-time senders wait for your OK
slack.appPerWorkspace: One @ocw app, installed per workspace — each keeps its own allow-list.
slack.oneClickNeedsSignIn: One-click needs cloud sign-in; Manual works without it.
slack.namesFromSlack: Names come from Slack automatically. IDs show on hover.
slack.noOneAllowed: No one allowed yet — mentions of the bot show up here for your OK.
slack.disconnectTitle: Stops relaying this workspace to this computer. The app stays installed in Slack.
slack.manualSteps2: Enable Socket Mode, add bot scopes, install it to your workspace
slack.oneModePause: One mode at a time — this pauses any relay workspaces.
slack.removeOwnerFirst: Remove approval-owner access before removing this person.

github.title: GitHub
github.appPerAccount: One @ocw-agent App, installed per account or org — you pick the repos on GitHub; each installation keeps its own allow-list.
github.oneClickNeedsSignIn: One-click needs cloud sign-in; a PAT works without it.
github.noOneAllowed: No one allowed yet — @ocw-agent mentions show up here for your OK.
github.disconnectTitle: Stops relaying this installation to this computer. The App stays installed on GitHub.
github.patToolsOnly: Personal access token · tools only. Install the GitHub App to let @-mentions and the agent label reach this computer.
github.triggers: Triggers: @ocw-agent mentions and the “ocw-agent” label. The agent replies as ocw-agent[bot].

gmail.title: Gmail
gmail.comingSoonTitle: One-click Google sign-in is coming soon
gmail.signInFirst: Sign in to WeruBWorker Cloud first
gmail.signInWithGoogle: Sign in with Google — each mailbox stays separate, agents say which one they use.
gmail.filtersEnforced: Filters are enforced on this computer, before an agent sees results. Hidden counts show on the tool card and in Activity — never the content.
gmail.matchingEmail: Matching email is silently left out of what agents read — no trace they could probe.

calendar.title: Google Calendar
calendar.signInWithGoogle: Sign in with Google — each account stays separate, agents say which one they use.
calendar.approvalNote: Creating, changing, or deleting events always asks for your approval first, and the approval names the account.

hubspot.title: HubSpot
hubspot.connectPortal: Connect a portal — read-only or read & write is chosen at consent; there are no delete tools either way.
hubspot.strippedNote: Stripped from every record agents read, across all portals.
hubspot.hiddenFieldsNote: Hidden fields never reach an agent; stripped counts land in Activity. To limit what a HUMAN teammate could ask for, use HubSpot permission sets on the connected user.

accounts.signInForOneClick: Sign in to WeruBWorker Cloud for one-click — or add a token below
accounts.accountsSeparate: Each account stays separate — tool results and approvals name the account they used.

modal.opensInBrowser: Opens {{title}} in your browser — sign in and approve access there. No tokens typed, and no WeruBWorker account needed: the sign-in runs entirely on this computer.
modal.curatedTools: agents get a curated set of {{title}} tools · tokens stay on this computer

shared.nobodyYet: nobody yet — pick a name, or approve a waiting sender below
shared.nobodyYetApprove: nobody yet — approve a waiting sender below
shared.chooseOwner: Choose at least one owner before routing Inbox approvals to Slack.
shared.fromDirectory: From your workspace directory — stays on this computer.
shared.allowDeliverTitle: Allow the sender and deliver this message now
shared.allowTitle: Allow the sender; this message is discarded
shared.allowMentionTitle: Allow the sender and deliver this mention now
shared.allowMentionDiscard: Allow the sender; this mention is discarded
